jobs.occupation: PhD Positions in Autonomous Drone Flight in Confined Spaces for Wind Turbine Inspection
jobs.description:
The SDU UAS Center, part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, invites applications for one or more PhD positions on autonomous flight in confined and cluttered environments for multi-rotor drones. The positions are for a three-year employment with a flexible start date.

 

What We Offer
The successful candidates will become part of the SDU UAS Center, where we conduct cutting-edge research in civilian drone technologies and future drone applications in critical sectors, such as agriculture, inspection, energy, and healthcare. At the heart of our mission is the creation of groundbreaking drone solutions that address key societal challenges. We are committed to fostering a dynamic and inspiring work environment where creativity flourishes. We often collaborate closely with world-leading companies, some of which are part of the vibrant robotic startup community around Odense.

The positions are tied to the development of an Automated Service Inspection (ASI) system for wind turbines, carried out in close collaboration with Vestas. Wind energy is a cornerstone of the green transition, yet the industry depends heavily on manual inspections and a shrinking pool of service technicians. Autonomous drones that can fly safely inside and around turbine structures are a key enabler for scalable, data-driven maintenance, promising less downtime, improved safety, and higher energy production across a growing global fleet.

 

Work Area
The successful candidates will conduct research and development within autonomous flight in confined spaces, where safety and robustness under real-world conditions are paramount. Flying close to and inside turbine structures, such as the tower interior, raises fundamental research challenges: navigation without reliable GNSS, perception in geometrically complex environments, and safe motion planning within centimetres of critical infrastructure. Concretely, the work will include the following:

• 
State estimation and localisation in GNSS-denied, confined environments (visual-inertial odometry (VIO), simultaneous localisation and mapping (SLAM), sensor fusion).

• 
Real-time perception.

• 
Motion planning and control for safe, agile flight in close proximity to obstacles and infrastructure.

• 
Prototyping of drones and payloads tailored to confined-space inspection, from concept and mechanical/electronics integration to flight-ready platforms.

• 
Integration of autonomy with onboard inspection payloads (cameras, microphones) and existing turbine data.

• 
Operation and flight testing of multi-rotor UAS, including experiments at turbine sites.

During the PhD studies, the successful candidates will also have the opportunity to work on related autonomy challenges across the center's project portfolio, where autonomous flight under demanding real-world conditions is a recurring theme.

The positions may involve co-supervising related student projects. The candidates will be part of the SDU UAS Center and are expected to participate in the center's project portfolio and outreach activities.

 

We Expect
We expect that you hold an MSc, or expect to complete one before the start date, in engineering, robotics, or computer science, or another related field. You do not need to cover every area below, but you should have experience with, and a genuine interest in, some of the following:

• 
Research and development within autonomous navigation, state estimation, or motion planning for robots or UAS.

• 
Research and development within UAS platforms, subsystems, and payloads.

• 
Prototyping of drones and payloads (mechanical design, electronics, systems integration).

• 
Perception and machine learning for robotics.

• 
Software design and development (C, C++, Python), including real-time and embedded systems.

• 
UAS operations (experiments, piloting).

We furthermore expect that you publish findings at recognised international conferences and in top-ranked, peer-reviewed journals.

For certain projects and tasks at the Drone Labs at HCA Airport, a security check by relevant authorities and a driving license are required.

For further information, please contact Prof. Anders Lyhne Christensen (andc@mmmi.sdu.dk) and Associate Prof. Robert Ladig (rola@mmmi.sdu.dk).

We look forward to receiving your application.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

• 
Motivated application. 

• 
Curriculum Vitae.

• 
Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation). 

• 
Completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

• 
Completed TEK PhD form for calculation grade point average. Find the form at the Faculty website. 

• 
An official document describing the grading scheme of the awarding universities (if not Danish). 

• 
Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

• 
List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications (in case you have any publications).

• 
References may be included, you're welcome to use the form for reference letter at the Faculty website.

• 
A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is October 1, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step.

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.occupation: Management Support Role to Service Operations - At the Heart of the Nordic Power System
jobs.description:
Are you motivated by supporting highly skilled engineers and contributing to the secure operation of the Nordic power system? Do you thrive in an environment where operational reliability, collaboration, and continuous improvement are essential?

At the Nordic Regional Coordination Centre, in the Service Operations department, you will work closely with a team of engineers delivering critical services to the Nordic Transmission System Operators around the clock. In the role, you will act as a daily sparring partner and facilitator for the engineering team, helping ensure effective coordination between control center duties and development activities outside the operator chair.

This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the security of supply and the Nordic green energy transition, while supporting the development of engineers working in a highly specialized operational environment.

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition

Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time.

Based in Copenhagen, Nordic RCC is one of six RCCs in Europe, equally owned by the Nordic region's four electricity TSOs: Fingrid, Statnett, Svenska Kraftnät, and Energinet.

As European power systems integrate and evolve to meet climate goals, Nordic RCC provides regional coordination, integrated services, regional insights and recommendations to the Nordic TSOs and their control centres, to support cross-border operational security 24/7.

Join Nordic RCC, a fast-developing company determined to make a significant impact in the energy sector and to provide for a secure and efficient transition to the green, sustainable energy system.

Right now, we are looking for a management support role who would like to make a difference!

Job description:

You would be supporting an engineering team that works in a hybrid setup, combining:

• 
Operator-on-shift roles in the Nordic RCC coordination centre, supporting Nordic TSOs around the clock

• 
Work outside the operational shift including projects, operational follow-up, and continuous improvement activities

Your primary focus will be daily coordination, professional sparring, and supporting the development of effective structures and ways of working across the team, supporting and facilitating the performance of these roles.

You will NOT be part of the Operator on-shift roster, who is performing the coordination centre tasks and services 24/7.

The position does not initially include formal personnel management, as the engineers in the setup today report directly to the Head of Department in Service Operations. You will work closely with the Head of Department on topics like department structure and set-up, and by providing day-to-day coordination and operational support, as well as mentoring and sparring on subject matter topics with the team.

Responsibilities:

• 
Driving department strategy and development in collaboration with the Head of Department (HoD) supporting effective coordination between coordination centre duties and non-operational activities, both within the team and externally towards other departments

• 
Facilitating knowledge sharing, supporting and securing continuous training and collaboration

• 
Supporting engineers in their professional development, and acting as a sparring partner, particularly those early in their careers

• 
Identifying opportunities to improve structures, processes, and operational workflows

• 
Supporting planning, prioritization, and follow-up across shifts, projects, and operational tasks

• 
Contributing to continuous improvement of service quality and operational efficiency as well as securing the level of contingency and business continuity

• 
The role will include sharing of responsibilities as part of 3rd line support with Head of Department as the department runs 24/7 operational services

Requirements:

You bring experience from a technical or operational environment and enjoy supporting the development and collaboration of highly skilled professionals.

We expect that you:

• 
Have experience working in a technical, operational, or knowledge-intensive organization

• 
Demonstrate strong ability to mentor, support, and collaborate with technical specialists

• 
Have experience identifying and improving structures, processes, and ways of working

• 
Are comfortable working in a complex environment with the responsibility of 24/7 operational services

• 
Communicate clearly and effectively across technical and organizational boundaries

Additional beneficial competencies include:

• 
Experience from the power system, electrical infrastructure, or energy sector

• 
Engineering or technical background

• 
Experience working in control centre or operational environments

• 
Familiarity with organizations delivering 24/7operational services

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the listed requirements.

What we offer

You will be joining a company of competent, diverse, and enthusiastic colleagues. We are currently 25 nationalities with over 30% women (striving to improve this balance) and all ages.

Your daily workplace will be in our newly furnished office premises in Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. We offer workplace flexibility to ensure a healthy work-life balance, including the possibility to work from home some of the time. 

Our values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency have been defined by all employees. They identify how we behave and shape the way we work together, and we expect you to see yourself in them.

jobs.occupation: Assistant Professor Position in Naval Architecture and Marine Engineering
jobs.description:
SDU Mechanical Engineering (SDU ME) invites applications for an Assistant Professor in Naval Architecture and Marine Engineering. SDU ME is part of the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME) at the Faculty of Engineering, University of Southern Denmark, located at the main campus in Odense. The position is available from January 1, 2027, with the specific start date to be agreed upon with the successful candidate.

 

The position and research environment 

You will join the maritime group at Mechanical Engineering, where the main research topics are seakeeping, data-driven maintenance, and energy systems and efficiency. The group works within applied research, carried out in close collaboration with industry and other research groups. The group is part of the larger Maritime Center at SDU, offering strong opportunities for transdisciplinary and cross-faculty collaboration. In addition, the center is actively developing strong relationships with external partners. The candidate is expected to play an active role in this community, contributing both to research and administrative activities within the center. This includes outreach to other universities, industry, maritime educational institutes, authorities, and professional organizations to establish and strengthen collaborative relationships.

Furthermore, SDU conducts defense-related research. The successful candidate is therefore expected to have an interest in dual-use research within the relevant research fields, and to actively engage in outreach to other universities as well as the Danish Defence.

To complement our team, we are looking for candidates within naval architecture and marine engineering / mechanical engineering, with documented research experience in one of the following fields:

• 
Data-driven operation of ships – Energy efficiency and predictive maintenance, digital twins, and the use of machine learning and sensor data to optimize vessel operation and efficiency.

• 
Seakeeping and comfort onboard vessels - ship motion analysis, ship stability, vibration and noise reduction, or human comfort and habitability at sea.

You will bring competence and dedication to teaching and student supervision in mechanical engineering at SDU ME, actively contributing to our two educational programs: Bachelor of Engineering (diplomingeniør) and Bachelor's and Master of Science (civilingeniør). Our engineering programs combine theory courses with project work, and you will be involved in both. 

 

Workplace

SDU ME is part of the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME) at the Faculty of Engineering, University of Southern Denmark, located at the main campus in Odense. The research activities at SDU ME span widely from fluid mechanics, multi-physics simulation and optimization to condition monitoring and structural dynamics, composite materials, mechanical design, and naval architecture and marine engineering. IME is a multidisciplinary department covering also high-frequency electronics, microelectronics, batteries and super-capacitors, additive manufacturing, smart structures and energy technologies. The department is an exciting environment, where you will be exposed to many different fields and have your general academic curiosity stimulated.

The position is full-time and located at the SDU main campus in Odense. Given the research, teaching, and collaborative nature of the position, you are expected to be present on campus on a regular basis and to relocate to Denmark, if currently residing abroad.

SDU Odense is the university’s largest campus and provides a strong framework for interdisciplinary research, teaching, and innovation. You will be part of a modern workplace with high professionalism, strong academic communities, and a commitment to diversity and equal opportunities. SDU also offers dedicated support for International Staff. Learn more about careers and work life at SDU here: Careers at SDU.

 

What we expect 

You must have:

• 
Completed a PhD degree in a relevant discipline

• 
The ability to teach basic mechanical engineering curricula

• 
Communication skills in English at an adequate level for research communication and teaching

It is preferred that you also have experience from/with:

• 
Postdoctoral research positions

• 
Co-supervision of PhD students

• 
Teaching and course development

• 
Funding applications

• 
Collaboration with industrial partners

You are expected to apply for own grants and to contribute to joint applications with the group and its collaborators. Strong potential to compete for national and international research funding is essential.

During the period of employment as Assistant Professor, you are expected to develop an independent research profile; publish high-quality research outputs; contribute to attracting external research funding; develop documented teaching and supervision competences, including completion of the Lecturer Training Programme; and contribute actively to collaboration, knowledge exchange, and the academic environment at SDU Mechanical Engineering.

 

Further information 

For more information about the position, contact Head of Section Associate Professor Dorte Smedegaard Schmidt (phone +45 65507432, e-mail dss@sdu.dk) or Professor Marie Lützen (phone +45 65509625, e-mail mlut@sdu.dk).

For more information about SDU ME, please see https://www.sdu.dk/da/mechanical.

For more information about IME, please see https://www.sdu.dk/en/ime. 

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

• 
Motivated application (up to 2 pages). 

• 
Complete Curriculum Vitae (up to 4 pages).

• 
Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

• 
Complete list of publications. 

• 
Up to 10 publications most relevant to the position. 

• 
Teaching Portfolio documenting teaching, learning, and supervision qualifications and approach. Any format is acceptable; see the Faculty's teaching portfolio page for inspiration.

• 
A proposed research plan (up to 4 pages).

• 
References/reference letters may be included.

• 
A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included. 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 1, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period.

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

jobs.occupation: Part-time Sushi Chef / Kitchen Assistant – Sushi Lovers Ordrup
jobs.description:

Salary according to qualifications and experience

Flexible shift planning via Planday

A young, international and informal team

Staff meals during shifts

Good opportunities for more hours and development within the company

Apply

Are you our new Automation Manager with a passion for technology, leadership, and scalable automation solutions?

At DESMI, you will play a key role in strengthening and scaling our automation capabilities across the organization. You will be part of product development & innovation leading a skilled engineering team in Denmark and China to develop reliable and future-proof automation solutions for both products and customized needs.
Working closely with Product Management, Projects, Production, and Service, you will ensure strong alignment between technical solutions and business requirements. You will be responsible for setting direction, creating structure across projects, and ensuring high quality delivery of automation solutions across DESMI’s global operations.
DESMI is a dynamic and innovative company where collaboration, continuous learning, and professional development are at the core of our culture. In this role, you will have the opportunity to influence the direction of our automation landscape, develop your team, and contribute to building scalable and efficient solutions that support our continued growth.

Ideally, we are looking for someone who is:

• Technically grounded
• Possess strong leadership and people management skills
• Structured and organized
A glimpse into the role
You will lead a team of automation engineers while ensuring that our solutions are robust and aligned with business needs. Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Team Leadership & Development: Lead, motivate, and develop a high-performing automation team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
• Project Execution & Prioritization: Plan, structure, and drive execution across multiple automation projects, ensuring clear priorities, efficient resource allocation, and on-time delivery.
• Technical Direction & Quality Assurance: Set the technical direction for automation solutions across hardware and software, ensuring reliable, serviceable, and future-proof designs.
• Operational Ownership of Automation Solutions: Oversee the development and maintenance of automation systems, translating business and product requirements into standardized, scalable technical solutions.
• Stakeholder Management: Act as the key point of contact for stakeholders across Product Management, Projects, Production, and Service, ensuring alignment and clear communication on scope, expectations, and deliverables.
• Process & Solution Optimization: Drive structured and transparent workflows across projects, continuously improving processes and enabling efficient and consistent delivery of automation solutions.
• Innovation & Continuous Improvement: Support the ongoing development of DESMI’s automation portfolio by promoting a solution-oriented mindset and identifying opportunities for innovation and standardization.
Your next opportunity starts here
We’re looking for an experienced and driven leader with a strong technical foundation in automation and a passion for developing both people and solutions. You thrive in a dynamic, international environment and are motivated by creating structure, driving progress, and delivering high-quality results together with your team.

We also imagine that you:

• Have minimum 5 years of leadership experience managing technical teams
• Bring a strong technical background within automation, electrical engineering, or a similar field, combined with hands-on experience in both hardware and software design
• Are structured and capable of creating clarity and overview in complex project environments with multiple ongoing activities
• Have strong planning and resource management skills, enabling you to prioritize effectively and ensure successful project execution
• Communicate clearly and proactively with stakeholders across functions and organizational levels
• Take a solution-oriented approach and are comfortable setting direction while supporting your team in delivering robust and scalable solutions
• Have experience working in a dynamic environment where priorities can shift, and where adaptability is key to success
• Are fluent in English, as it is DESMI’s corporate language
The perks of being at DESMI

• Flexible working hours – including possibilities for remote work.
• Global career prospects – work with colleagues across Europe, Asia, and the U.S.
• Skills development and career growth – Training, job rotation, and internal mobility
• Pension – attractive employer contributions
• Private healthcare and life insurance
• On-site canteen – light breakfast, lunch buffet, and snacks
• Company sports & social activities – from badminton and bowling to art clubs and summer parties
What we’re about
But we’re more than just pumps. At DESMI, we believe teamwork and innovation drive success.
When you join DESMI, you can expect:

• A collaborative and supportive team environment.
• Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development.
• A chance to contribute your ideas and make a real impact.
• A company that values sustainability and innovation.
We are a flat organization with an open-door policy, where decisions are made together, and ideas are always welcome. Here, doers thrive – if you see an opportunity for improvement, you have the freedom to act on it.
As innovators in reliable and sustainable flow solutions, we serve a wide range of industries from Aquaculture and Defense to Green Technologies – the list goes on. Sustainability is highly appreciated while developing high-performance and long-lasting technologies that help industries adapt to evolving markets while reducing environmental impact.

Ready to apply?
If you're a dedicated and motivated individual seeking a challenging and rewarding career where you can contribute to a more sustainable future, we encourage you to apply!

To learn more about this please contact Søren Flummer (SORF@desmi.com). We are reviewing applications on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
